profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Consumers Energy
profile.summary:
I'm a tech lead and senior .NET engineer with over a decade in software--eight years building backend systems and five leading the people who build them. I currently lead an 8-person development team that owns high-throughput services in an event-driven microservices platform: ~200 services moving ~50M messages a day, including the platform's second-largest message consumer.

My proudest accomplishment isn't a service I shipped or a query I got running several times faster (those were pretty great too). It's a team. When I took over my current team, it was quietly competent: nobody spoke in meetings, and work got done only when it was handed over. Today that same core group vigorously debates architecture, drives its own process improvements, and takes fierce pride in what it ships. Building that kind of ownership culture is what I think leadership is for.

On the technical side, I'm currently leading my team's migration from MSMQ/NServiceBus to Azure Service Bus and driving its adoption of agentic AI coding workflows. Before software I practiced law as a solo attorney: a background that turns out to be surprisingly useful for writing requirements, negotiating scope, and arguing about code reviews.

positions.title: Digital Engineering Mgmt. Senior Manager (Engineering Manager / Tech Lead)
positions.description:
I lead an 8-person development team building backend services for Press Ganey (now part of Qualtrics), the industry leader in healthcare experience measurement. Our team owns high-throughput services in an event-driven microservices platform of ~200 services processing ~50M messages/day — including the platform's second-largest message consumer at ~10M messages/day.
 
I architect new services for the platform and am currently leading our migration from MSMQ/NServiceBus to Azure Service Bus. I also drive the team's adoption of agentic AI coding, partnering with other leads to tune and troubleshoot an automated AI code-review agent in our GitLab CI/CD pipeline. Beyond my own team, I mentor developers across the organization and conduct cognitive and behavioral interviews for engineering hiring.
 
Tech: C#, .NET 8, .NET Framework 4.8, SQL Server, IBM DB2, NServiceBus, MSMQ, Azure Service Bus, GitLab CI/CD

positions.description: Promoted from Senior Developer II to lead delivery for a 6-person development team serving Press Ganey, while retaining hands-on technical leadership of the team's services.

positions.locationName: Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States · On-site
positions.description: Built and owned a backend reporting service that dynamically generated custom SQL Server queries from client-configured parameters, then aggregated and transformed the results into client-facing report files. Heavy focus on SQL Server query tuning to keep large, dynamically generated analytical queries fast at scale.

positions.locationName: Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States · On-site
